To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a nadir checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 238 dollars and 15 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
